# Load the data

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float

# Check for internal test orders: revenue = 999999.99
test_orders = data[data['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of internal test orders: {len(test_orders)}")

# Filter for completed orders and exclude test orders
completed_orders = data[(data['status'] == 'completed') & (data['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)]

# Compute total revenue
total_revenue = completed_orders['revenue_clean'].sum()

# Output the result
total_revenue"}
